_source: 2026-09-07. UI sfx pool = FDOTHER.DAT resource #31 (nested LLLLLL, 14 sub-samples), used as table_ptr [0x53eec] by play_sfx_a (0x25a96) / play_sfx_b (0x25b45).
_method: No listening involved. Each index is judged from three independent sources: (a) the enclosing function of its play_sfx call site, decompiled and cross-referenced against functions this project had already named elsewhere; (b) measured properties of the corresponding raw 8-bit PCM sample, re-extracted from FDOTHER.DAT this round rather than reusing the deleted remake/assets copy; (c) how often / at what moment the call site fires. This is the same shape of argument that upgraded index 0 to CONFIRMED.
_waveform_measurements: re-measured 2026-09-07 at the documented 11025Hz assumption; columns are bytes, ms, min, max, peak-to-peak, RMS about 128, and the share of samples within +/-2 of the 128 silence centre
_correction_to_doc36: doc36's sub-sample table calls #5/#6 '幾乎全 0x80 (近似靜音段)'. Measured, they are rms 5.18 / 3.95 with peak-to-peak 40 / 32 -- quiet, but the same order as #0 (p2p 32, rms 9.16), not near-silence. 'Low amplitude' is accurate; 'nearly silent' overstates it.

2.enclosing: UI main-loop animation tick: increments a counter, advances a 0..3 frame cycle every 2nd call, redraws (FUN_00016559), plays sfx on EVERY call; both callers (0x16139, 0x164a2) are inside FUN_00015f84, the core UI routine every town/church/shop loop calls
2.argument: fires every tick, so a loud sample would be a continuous racket; it measures as one of the shortest and quietest in the pool

3.enclosing: death handler: scans every unit for record[+5]&1 == 0 (not yet flagged dead) AND HP-current (record+0x40) == 0, runs a 13-frame animation, then sets record[+5] = 1
3.argument: longest sample in the pool and among the widest dynamic range; cross-checks with the 2026-09-07 revival work, which independently established record[+5]&1 = dead and that revival clears it and restores HP

4.enclosing: 0x1A30B, the turn orchestrator doc11 documents as the single destination of all three end-turn entries

5.enclosing: unit info / status card display (the same routine church service 0 calls after picking a member); this site is preceded by 0x4e8af taking a string pointer
5.semantics: text/message shown inside the info card (unconfirmed which half)
5.confidence: MEDIUM -- 5 and 6 are byte-identical in length and both low amplitude, which suggests a paired open/close or show/hide, but the pairing direction is not established

6.semantics: the other half of the same pair

7.enclosing: field cursor/confirm handler -- doc11 records that this function calls the 0x16F55 system ring when there is no actionable friendly unit under the cursor; sfx 7 plays on the branch where a bit test FAILS
7.argument: exactly the same length as index 0 (the soft cursor blip) but roughly 3x the RMS and zero silence -- a short, harsh, dense click, which is the shape a refusal buzzer has and a cursor tick does not

8.enclosing: ring key-reading routine (doc11 lists 0x1741C/0x177FC as the readers for the 0x16F55 system ring); the site follows setting four dwords to 0x390

11.call_site: 0x2cac3 in an un-boundaried function starting 0x2c67d (recovered with tools/find_enclosing_function.py; Ghidra has no boundary there, so no decompile)
11.confidence: LOW -- a 221ms sample on a 1-in-9 cadence does not obviously fit a tick; the enclosing function still needs to be decompiled

_live_confirmation_2026_09_07.tool: tools/fd2_sfx_probe.py (built this round, --selftest pins index 0 + a known direction call site)
_live_confirmation_2026_09_07.method: breakpoint on play_sfx_a (Ghidra 0x25a96, live 0x1C1A96 at delta 0x19c000), resume, perform an action, then read the caller's 3-push frame off the stack: [esp+0] return address, [esp+4] table_ptr, [esp+8] index, [esp+c] priority
_live_confirmation_2026_09_07.calling_convention: doc36's documented 3-push order (table_ptr, index, priority) is now LIVE-VERIFIED, not just read off disassembly

index_0_CONFIRMED_LIVE.note: 4 of the 5 direction-key branches doc36 lists were each observed firing with index 0 after pressing the matching direction key (left->0x11a75, right->0x11a96, down->0x11a54). Previously index 0 rested on waveform length plus static call-site reading.

index_7_CONFIRMED_LIVE.trigger: pressing confirm with the cursor on a unit whose bit test fails in FUN_000117e7
index_7_CONFIRMED_LIVE.screen_at_the_call: docs/figures/ch27-sfx-index7-refusal-moment.png -- the cursor sits on a unit (mini status card shows HP 782) and NO info card opens, which is the branch doc36 describes as 'test fails -> play 7, else call 0x17aed'
index_7_CONFIRMED_LIVE.reproducible: hit twice with the same call site

index_10_NEW_not_in_doc36.observation: fired in battle after two DIFFERENT keys (an unbound key and a direction key), so it is not caused by the key pressed -- something plays it periodically
index_10_NEW_not_in_doc36.waveform: sfx_10 is the quietest sample in the pool (rms 3.32, 72.3% within +/-2 of silence, 299.7ms)
index_10_NEW_not_in_doc36.semantics: NOT established -- consistent with an ambient/idle loop, but not demonstrated

_live_confirmation_2026_09_07.method_limitation: probe() resumes and reports the NEXT play_sfx call, which is not necessarily the one the action caused. Whenever a periodic sound is active (as index 10 is in battle), a single observation cannot be attributed to a keypress; attribution needs either a quiet context or repeated trials that separate the two.
tool_defects_found_and_fixed_this_round: the debugger's D view is 16-byte aligned, so an unaligned ESP silently produced no row and the observation was dropped
arm() calibrated the delta before entering the debugger, but MEMDUMPBIN does nothing while the guest runs
an empty dump was reported as a parse failure instead of the truth: no breakpoint hit

a stale pane could show an EIP a few bytes past the breakpoint and the stack was read anyway -- an unbound-key negative control exposed this as index=2129944 from a negative call site; the tool now requires EIP to equal the breakpoint exactly

_live_confirmation_round2_2026_09_07.method: breakpoint at each index's OWN call site (not at play_sfx_a's entry), so the stopped EIP identifies the index without having to guess which action caused the next generic call. At a call-site stop the frame is [esp]=table_ptr, [esp+4]=index, [esp+8]=priority.

index_2.semantics: played every UI main-loop tick while a message window animates open

index_3.trigger_built: a roster record patched to HP-current 0 AND HP-max 0 (max 0 makes the turn-start regen loop skip it, since that loop requires HP != HPmax) with the dead bit clear, so the death handler sees it

index_4.CORRECTION: earlier this file recorded index 4 as 'turn change' with HIGH confidence. That label is WRONG. FUN_0001a30b's first loop sets a flag only for own-side units that are alive, status-free and BELOW full HP; the sfx is played only if that flag is set, and the loop right after it applies HP += HPmax/5.
index_4.semantics: turn-start HP regeneration (plays only when at least one own unit is damaged)

paired_control.negative: all units at full HP -> turn counter [0x53bef] advanced 1->2 but the breakpoint did NOT fire
paired_control.positive: one unit patched to 306/918 -> breakpoint fired, index 4

index_5_and_6.CORRECTION: earlier guessed as an open/close pair on equal sample lengths. They are SEQUENTIAL stages of the same spell-list display: 6 fires first, gated on FUN_0001c269 returning non-zero, then 5 fires right after FUN_0001ceed renders the list.
index_5_and_6.gate: FUN_0001c269(unit, out) counts set bits across the 5 bytes at record+0x1a..0x1e, i.e. the unit's learned-spell bitmask; index 6 plays only when the unit knows at least one spell

index_11_and_9.finding: doc36's site for 0xb (0x2cac3) does NOT hold in this EXE -- that address is a `cmp`, and the counter beside it is mod-10 with no idiv. The real site is 0x32307, inside FUN_00032230, and it serves TWO indices through a compiler tail-merge: 0x322c5 `push 1; push 9; jmp 0x32301` and 0x322fd `push 1; push 0xb` both fall into the shared `push pool; call` tail at 0x32301/0x32307.
index_11_and_9.selection: a 29-byte class table at 0x52725 indexed by record+0x20 minus 1: byte 0 -> period 6, byte 1 -> period 4, both playing index 9; byte >=2 -> period 9, playing index 0xb. Distribution: 19 classes period 4, 6 classes period 6, 4 classes period 9 (classes 3, 11, 15, 19).
index_11_and_9.semantics: per-unit periodic cadence tick driven by the global counter DAT_00054132
index_11_and_9.live: 12 consecutive hits all read index 9; moving the cursor to a different unit produced index 11, exactly as the class branch predicts
index_11_and_9.RETRACTION: this file previously recorded 'index 10 from call site 0x32307, a new pair not in doc36'. That reading was taken BEFORE the probe had a running-state guard, so the register block it decoded was from an earlier stop. The correct values are 9 and 11.

current_exe_call_site_table.method: byte-signature scan for `6a <prio>; 6a <index>; ff 35 ec 3e 05 00; e8 <rel32>`
current_exe_call_site_table.caveat: a signature scan cannot see tail-merged pushes -- 0x32307 was attributed to 0xb alone when it also serves index 9 from a jump into the middle of the sequence

_live_call_site_confirmation_2026_09_08.what_the_item_asked_for: item 587 自陳「仍缺的一步:把高信心項升級為『確認』還差對呼叫端下斷點的實機命中比對」。本輪做到了,方法本身也因此得到驗證。
_live_call_site_confirmation_2026_09_08.environment: instance `sfx3`,ch27 存檔,教會服務 0(狀態卡)。以 `tools/fd2_sfx_probe.py --arm-sites` 同時在多個呼叫端下斷點,再逐一操作介面讀取命中。
results: **index 5 = 開啟狀態卡**(呼叫端 `0x17c56`)——在名冊選單按確認開卡時命中,`index=5, priority=1`。
**index 6 = 關閉狀態卡**(呼叫端 `0x17b2e`)——按 Escape 關卡時命中,`index=6, priority=1`。
**這解掉本項自陳的『index 5/6 …配對方向未定』**:方向確定為 5=開、6=關,且是實機命中而非波形推論。
**index 2 的描述獲得修正**:本項原記『UI 主迴圈動畫 tick,所在函式每次呼叫都播』。實測:在**靜態狀態卡上靜置 8 秒完全不觸發**,但一按 Escape 或在名冊選單按方向鍵**立即命中**(`0x16546`,`index=2`)。故它是**重繪驅動**,不是時鐘 tick——「每次呼叫都播」成立,但「tick」這個字暗示的週期性不成立。
_live_call_site_confirmation_2026_09_08.method_now_proven: 三次獨立命中(5、6、2)全部 `matches_doc36: True`,證明『呼叫端斷點 + 讀取推入的 frame』這條路在本 build 可用,不受先前 VGA 層 BPPM 不可信問題影響(那是記憶體寫入斷點,這是執行斷點)。
_live_call_site_confirmation_2026_09_08.bonus_finding: 狀態卡本身順帶獨立證實了 item 248 的職業名表:索爾顯示為「**魔族 劍聖**」,而其 record `+0x20`(職業)=9,經 `class + 0x96` 得 FDTXT_000 索引 159 = 劍聖;「魔族」則落在本輪新解出的 141..150 種族段(145)。**由遊戲自己的 UI 交叉驗證,不是自說自話。**
_live_call_site_confirmation_2026_09_08.tool_bug_fixed: `tools/fd2_sfx_probe.py` 的子行程輸出原本沿用系統預設編碼(本機 cp950),一遇到中文或非法位元組就以 `UnicodeDecodeError` 崩潰,且崩在校準階段、訊息誤導成「delta calibration failed」。已改為 `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'`,並補上 stderr 的 utf-8 設定。
